id: go-nethttp-security-headers-middleware-missing-nosniff
title: Security headers middleware sets CSP/Permissions-Policy but omits X-Content-Type-Options
summary: 'An HTTP handler sets hardening headers such as Content-Security-Policy or Permissions-Policy
  but does not set

  `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`. Browsers may then MIME-sniff responses (for example user-uploaded
  or proxied

  images) and reinterpret them as HTML or JS, which enables XSS. The same middleware typically also lacks
  a

  Referrer-Policy, which leaks URL paths to other origins.

  '
cwe:
- CWE-693
severity: low
confidence: medium
languages:
- go
source:
  kind: fix-commit
  ref: 78d6de6bce1e961f023969da3ec8a00dd80c9ae8
  vulnerable_ref: 78d6de6bce1e961f023969da3ec8a00dd80c9ae8^
  patched_ref: 78d6de6bce1e961f023969da3ec8a00dd80c9ae8
  repository: https://github.com/umputun/remark42
rule:
  message: 'This handler sets security headers (CSP / Permissions-Policy) but never sets

    `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`. Add it, and also set a Referrer-Policy, in the same middleware.

    '
  patterns:
  - pattern-either:
    - pattern: $W.Header().Set("Content-Security-Policy", ...)
    - pattern: $W.Header().Set("Permissions-Policy", ...)
  - pattern-inside: "func($W http.ResponseWriter, $R *http.Request) {\n  ...\n}\n"
  - pattern-not-inside: "func($W http.ResponseWriter, $R *http.Request) {\n  ...\n  $W.Header().Set(\"\
      X-Content-Type-Options\", ...)\n  ...\n}\n"
fix:
  guidance: 'In the security headers middleware, set `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` and a `Referrer-Policy`

    (for example `strict-origin-when-cross-origin`) next to the Content-Security-Policy and Permissions-Policy

    headers, so every response carries them.

    '
  example: 'w.Header().Set("Content-Security-Policy", csp)

    w.Header().Set("Permissions-Policy", permissionsPolicy)

    w.Header().Set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")

    w.Header().Set("Referrer-Policy", "strict-origin-when-cross-origin")

    next.ServeHTTP(w, r)

    '
